shortDescription: Manages a VMware VMkernel Adapter of an ESXi host.

options.name: device
options.description: Search VMkernel adapter by device name. The parameter is required only in case of O(network.type=dhcp).

options.name: dvswitch_name
options.description: The name of the vSphere Distributed Switch (vDS) where to add the VMKernel interface. Required parameter only if O(state=present). Optional parameter from version 2.8 and onwards.

options.name: enable_backup_nfc
options.description: Enable vSphere Backup NFC traffic on the VMKernel adapter. This option is only allowed if the default TCP/IP stack is used.

options.name: enable_ft
options.description: Enable Fault Tolerance traffic on the VMKernel adapter. This option is only allowed if the default TCP/IP stack is used.

options.name: enable_mgmt
options.description: Enable Management traffic on the VMKernel adapter. This option is only allowed if the default TCP/IP stack is used.

options.name: enable_provisioning
options.description: Enable Provisioning traffic on the VMKernel adapter. This option is only allowed if the default TCP/IP stack is used.

options.name: enable_replication
options.description: Enable vSphere Replication traffic on the VMKernel adapter. This option is only allowed if the default TCP/IP stack is used.

options.name: enable_replication_nfc
options.description: Enable vSphere Replication NFC traffic on the VMKernel adapter. This option is only allowed if the default TCP/IP stack is used.

options.name: enable_vmotion
options.description: Enable vMotion traffic on the VMKernel adapter. This option is only allowed if the default TCP/IP stack is used. You cannot enable vMotion on an additional adapter if you already have an adapter with the vMotion TCP/IP stack configured.

options.name: enable_vsan
options.description: Enable VSAN traffic on the VMKernel adapter. This option is only allowed if the default TCP/IP stack is used.

options.name: esxi_hostname
options.description: Name of ESXi host to which VMKernel is to be managed.

options.name: hostname
options.description: The hostname or IP address of the vSphere vCenter server. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable E(VMWARE_HOST) will be used instead.

options.name: mtu
options.description: The MTU for the VMKernel interface. The default value of 1500 is valid from version 2.5 and onwards.

options.name: network
options.description: A dictionary of network details.

options.name: password
options.description: The password of the vSphere vCenter server. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable E(VMWARE_PASSWORD) will be used instead.

options.name: port
options.description: The port number of the vSphere vCenter server. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable E(VMWARE_PORT) will be used instead.

options.name: portgroup_name
options.description: The name of the port group for the VMKernel interface.

options.name: proxy_host
options.description: The address of a proxy that will receive all HTTPS requests and relay them. The format is a hostname or a IP. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable E(VMWARE_PROXY_HOST) will be used instead.

options.name: proxy_port
options.description: The port of the HTTP proxy that will receive all HTTPS requests and relay them. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable E(VMWARE_PROXY_PORT) will be used instead.

options.name: state
options.description: If set to V(present), the VMKernel adapter will be created with the given specifications. If set to V(absent), the VMKernel adapter will be removed. If set to V(present) and VMKernel adapter exists, the configurations will be updated.

options.name: username
options.description: The username of the vSphere vCenter server. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable E(VMWARE_USER) will be used instead.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Allows connection when SSL certificates are not valid. Set to V(false) when certificates are not trusted. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable E(VMWARE_VALIDATE_CERTS) will be used instead.

options.name: vswitch_name
options.description: The name of the vSwitch where to add the VMKernel interface. Required parameter only if O(state=present). Optional parameter from version 2.5 and onwards.
